name: York Imperial Plastics Inc
old_description: The decision to transfer your tooling may be a difficult one.  Perhaps your current supplier is not meeting your quality standards, or they lack the current capacity to meet your order requirements.  With over 500 successful mold transfers since 1985, York Imperial Plastics specializes in the execution of transfer tooling including those requiring rework and modifications.
about:
Founded in 1985, York Imperial Plastics is a second-generation family-owned and operated plastic injection molding facility in York, Pennsylvania. The company began as a custom molding operation and has since expanded into a full-service provider of tooling transfer, design, and production.

The company runs an all-inclusive custom plastic injection molding operation, offering services from prototype through high-volume production. Its capabilities include mold transfer and rework — with over 500 successful transfers since 1985 — multi-cavity high-production tool design, master unit die (MUD) capability, in-house assembly and packaging, and daily direct shipping. Quality processes cover APQP, PPAP, first-article inspection, CMM and optical measurement, color spectrophotometry, statistical process control, and moisture analysis.

York Imperial serves manufacturers that need custom plastic injection molded parts, tooling transfer, or turnkey assembly and shipping. Customers include those requiring rework or modification of existing tools, as well as companies seeking a single source for prototype-to-production molding, value-added assembly, and direct delivery.

The company differentiates itself through a made-in-America tool warranty on every tool it builds, ISO 9001 certification, and a quality culture that makes quality every employee's responsibility. Its founding family's values remain central, emphasizing strong partnerships and continuous improvement across all operations.
